witness.branch: Straight traversal from a right-turn-lane approach
witness.quote: While being driven in the right turn lane, not travel through an intersection.
witness.reason: A straight route can physically traverse the intersection from the designated lane without changing its right-turn designation.
required_context: Apply separate-intersection treatment if the supplied 30-foot divided-roadway condition is present.
Ego occupies the designated lane on approach and follows a physically connected straight trajectory across the junction.
Establish highway status, exclusive turning design and ego's occupancy of that lane.
Provide a connected straight trajectory through a qualifying non-alley intersection and retain roadway boundaries excluding shoulders.
Public-highway status and a single right lane designed exclusively for turning.
Retain the full footprint and trajectory; preserve the undefined meaning of travel through rather than treating entry alone as sufficient.
